articles.title: Lithium‑ion batteries found burned after 2‑alarm fire at Toronto shelter hotel
articles.summary: Toronto Fire is investigating yet another incident involving lithium‑ion batteries after a two‑alarm fire broke out early Wednesday inside a city‑run shelter operating out of a former hotel in Etobicoke. articles.title: Ford could call byelections in 3 Ontario ridings today
articles.summary: Wednesday is the last day Premier Doug Ford can call a byelection in Scarborough Southwest, where the provincial seat has been vacant since February. But he could call elections in two other ridings where the spots are also open.

articles.title: Trial of man accused of killing his nine-year-old daughter to wrap up its second week
articles.summary: ELIZABETHTOWN — More testimonies are scheduled today in the trial of a man accused of killing his nine-year-old daughter last summer during a trip to New York.

articles.title: Motorcyclist dead following vehicle collision in Brampton: police
articles.summary: A motorcyclist is dead following a collision with a vehicle in Brampton Tuesday morning, Peel police say.

articles.title: 1 dead in Scarborough apartment fire
articles.summary: One person is dead after a fire broke out in a Scarborough apartment building Tuesday morning, Toronto police and paramedics say.

articles.title: Canadian 'vigilantes' confronted New York sex offender 2 years before arrest
articles.summary: The FBI investigated a New York man in 2024 after Canadian 'vigilantes' confronted him and warned he had travelled to sexually abuse a minor. It took another two years and a girl’s disappearance for the man to be arrested and charged, according to U.S. court records reviewed by CBC News.

articles.title: Toronto native Evan Gold named Hamilton Hammers GM
articles.summary: The New York Islanders announced Monday that Evan Gold has been hired as general manager of the Hamilton Hammers, the club's American Hockey League (AHL) affiliate.

articles.title: 2 women dead after Highway 401 collision near Gananoque
articles.summary: Two women from the Greater Toronto Area were killed Monday after their vehicle hit a tractor-trailer parked on the shoulder of Highway 401 near Gananoque, Ont., according to the Ontario Provincial Police.
